layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.

layers.text: Subject: Brontosaurus, a huge heavy cute giant long-necked dinosaur seen from the side, the biggest animal of the army: one enormous round barrel body, four very thick short pillar legs, a thick neck rising from the front of the body to a big round smiling head with sleepy friendly eyes, and a long thick tail; deep blue hide with a dark navy back, a cream belly and throat, and big solid bright orange blotches along the back and down the back of the neck; no neck bands, no blanket, no red and no player colour.

It is a four-legged animal: it stands on all four legs with its body level, never upright on two legs, and it has no arms and no hands. Its huge round body and tail fill the whole width of the image, and its neck is thick and short enough that the head stays inside the image. It holds nothing and carries no rider, no saddle and no blanket. It is lit from the left.
